ev.q: The party fights using light and heavy melee attacks when within range
a post-game storyline with its own class
the other two functioning as companions
joyful moments of whimsy and weirdness
Fighting enemies is rewarded with experience points, which raise a character's health
Also found are Item Seeds, which can be planted in special pots in towns
Wallace found the experience enjoyable despite needing to grind for levels
found exploring the map dull due to a lack of interesting finds
praise going to its redesigned combat and soundtrack
